subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or adopt the conflicting fork PR so this issue can proceed with a fresh active-runtime fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open fork PR with closing syntax is still attached even though it is conflicting and aimed at obsolete code.

options.title: Replace the fork with a fresh fix
options.body: Close or disregard the conflicting fork PR, then allow a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

options.title: Ask the fork author to rebuild
options.body: Have the fork author rebase and reduce the branch to the active runtime path before this issue enters a repair lane.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the existing conflicting fork PR, accepting that no current same-repo landing path exists.

recommendation.title: Replace the fork with a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or disregard the conflicting fork PR, then allow a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-file history and adjacent approval SDK work make this the best available routing candidate for the queue-or-replace decision.
